name: Birch Branch Campground
note: Small primitive sites beside Tellico River Rd (FR 210), about 15 miles above Tellico Plains and 400 m upstream of Davis Branch; a picnic table, fire ring and lantern post at each. The Forest Service gives no rig length and no camper report confirms a 23-ft rig fits, so pad size is unconfirmed. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/birch-branch-campground (read 2026-11-25, 'Site Open', page updated 2025-03-20): FS campground on Tellico River Rd (FS Rd 210), campsites with picnic table/fire ring/lantern post, 'Single Site: $10 per night', 'Open year-round', vault toilet; rec.gov facility 10158648 active (is_deactivated false), 'first-come, first-served basis only', Scan & Pay; The Dyrt lists it drive-in with parking at the site (2021 review: sites right next to the road). No rig length stated anywhere and no RV-fit report -> kept as an unclear-pad-size entry with a caveat (AWH 2026-11-02). Public, no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-25: Esri World_Imagery at 35.2824,-84.0971 is canopy-blind - one small gravel clearing at the FS point, the Tellico River and road hidden under closed canopy (so the river is well under ~30 m here: creekside at most). Esri topo puts the FS point between River Rd and the Tellico River, roughly 20-30 m from the stream. No per-site map, no rec.gov per-site tags (one placeholder 'Standard' site), no site photos; FS 'wake ... and start fishing' and Hipcamp 'right on Tellico River' are marketing/aggregator prose and cannot be the basis. No qualifying source names pads at the water -> default down to not waterfront. Lead: a creekside candidate if dated photos show pads at the stream with an easy walk down.

fees.note: $10 a site a night; at most 5 people and 2 vehicles a site. Pay on site (Recreation.gov Scan & Pay).

fees_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/birch-branch-campground ('Single Site: $10 per night'; 'Fee is $10 per site (7 sites)'; 'Maximum of 5 people and 2 vehicles at each site'), read 2026-11-25; Scan & Pay from rec.gov 10158648 overview, read 2026-11-25

flags: Site count not given: the FS page says both 'offers 5 campsites' and 'Fee is $10 per site (7 sites)' (Hipcamp also says 7); rec.gov carries a single placeholder 'Standard' site. sites group omitted.

Hookups group omitted: primitive sites (table/fire ring/lantern post) and no potable water, but no source states electric/water/sewer, and the rec.gov catalog (1 placeholder site) is too small to read electric 0 from.
rec.gov facility point 35.2855,-84.1316 is ~3.1 km W of the campground; the FS page point 35.2825,-84.0971 and the OSM node 35.28227,-84.09723 match the imagery clearing - pinned there.
Phone is the Tellico Ranger Station (same as Davis Branch 4418); rec.gov lists none.
Unclear pad size: no FS length, no camper RV report (only a 2021 motorcycle review on The Dyrt) - kept with a caveat in the note.

Possible further leads (not vetted): rec.gov lists Cherokee NF Tellico campgrounds Holder Cove (10158728, 35.2682,-84.0851), Rough Ridge (10158837, 35.2609,-84.0842) and Spivey Cove (10158862, 35.3039,-84.1131); no DB entry carries those names. Nearest entries are Big Oak Cove 4417 (~465 m from Holder Cove), State Line 4416 (~334 m from Rough Ridge) and North River 4419 (~2 km from Spivey Cove); rec.gov points can be km off, so confirm they are separate campgrounds first.
No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: Smokies 54 km) - irrelevant for a federal campground.
